Après la saisie du code postal, proposez: After entering the postal code, propose the corresponding communes in a readable list. If multiple results exist, do not automatically choose the first. The client must be able to specify his municipality or indicate that his place does not appear. Record the original text, the selected commune and its administrative identifier as separate information. A subsequent change in the postal code must trigger a new check of the common-post code couple, rather than silently keeping the old choice.

Dans un jeu d’essai fictif, paramétrez D: In a fictional trial game, set Doussard as the usual sector and Giez as the area to study. Submit two applications with {n0}: their results must differ depending on the commune selected. Submit the code only; the folder must remain incomplete. The same result provides two postal codes for Talloires-Montmin: {n3} and {n4}. This answer shows why the system should keep the chosen commune with the postal code entered. It does not describe a commercial tour, travel time or the sectors that a company actually agrees to serve.
Le code postal est pratique pour commenc: The postal code is convenient to start a search, but it is not always enough to identify a municipality. For home service, a rule such as "{n0} = accepted intervention" may therefore be too broad. The useful automation is to lift the ambiguity and then apply the perimeter decided by the company, without confusing receipt of a request with a confirmed displacement.
Le référentiel public doit être actualis: The public repository must be updated; the list cited corresponds to the dated check in the sources. It does not prove that a journey is possible or that a niche is free. The service setting of the example is fictitious and does not describe any real business.
Préparez une règle validée par l’entrepr: Prepare a rule validated by the company with three issues: usually served sector, area to be studied, unserved sector. The first may open the qualification of need, but does not promise an available niche. The second creates a verification task with the missing address or the exception pattern. The third shows a consistent explanation with your intervention policy. An entire municipality may remain too rough if your perimeter depends on access or location: in this case, keep a human validation.

Si la recherche de communes échoue, le f: If the search for communes fails, the form must keep the information already completed and allow an application to qualify. An unavailable external service does not mean that the customer lives outside the area. Also avoid calculating a travel time from a simple central point of town. If your organisation uses a route calculation, it must have the necessary place and an appropriate validation rule; this calculation remains separate from the administrative control of the municipality.
